Pull all RecFIN data files from the server

pullData.Rd

Pulls the primary recreational data within one function and saves each file as an .Rdata file. This script is not intended for everyone to run, rather it is for the data provider.

Usage

pullData(
  path = getwd(),
  species = NULL,
  username = pacfintools::getUserName("PacFIN"),
  password = pacfintools:::ask_password(),
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

path

A file path to the directory where the files are to be saved. The default is the current working directory.

species

The species name that the files represent. Can be a single name, or a vector of multiple names. The user must enter a value for this. Is case insensitive.

username

Username to access the recfin database of interest. Default is to automatically set using pacfintools::getUserName()

password

Password to access the recfin database. Default is to prompt user to enter using pacfintools::ask_password()

verbose

Whether to print a message about the files that were saved. Default is TRUE.

Value

A message alerting the user of the names and number of files that were saved to path.

Details

This function currently focuses on the eight primary RecFIN reports as available on the RecFIN Dashboard: CTE501: Recent catch data CTE008: MRFSS catch data CTE503: Washington historical catch reconstruction CTE507: Oregon historical catch reconstruction CTE508: California historical catch reconstruction SD501: Recent length bds data SD506: Recent age bds data SD517: MRFSS type 3 bds data Historical catch files are pulled for each of the three states separately but are saved as a single list object. All other files are pulled and saved individually

See also

readData() Reads the data pulled by this function

pacfintools::getUserName(), pacfintools::ask_password which are inputs to this function
